card-number-input.name: Card Number Input
card-number-input.purpose: Capture one grouped card number with numeric keyboard, cc-number autocomplete, local Luhn validation, helper/error copy, and Design System field states.
card-number-input.referenceRationale: The reference onboarding system captures card number with Field + Input, mono value, credit-card icon, grouping, and a validate action. Design System promotes the number field because Luhn validation and sensitive recovery rules exceed generic Input.

anatomy.rule: Names the card number field and remains visible.
Uses Input rhythm, density, focus, and state model.
Signals card capture without replacing label or helper.
Formats digits into readable groups while preserving raw digits for callbacks.
Uses Luhn only for local structure and never claims backend approval.

card-number-input.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > valid > filled > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic field surface, error, valid, and disabled color.
Energy.behavior: Card number state is visible and contrast-safe.

Voice.decision: Use direct helper and recovery copy without implying approval.
Voice.behavior: Users know whether to correct local structure.
Voice.rejectIf: Copy says the card is approved.

Frame.decision: Reuse Input geometry, density, and full-width behavior.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System focus and loading motion only.

State.decision: Disabled and loading resolve before local validation.
State.example: Loading backend check after valid local number.
State.rejectIf: Invalid and valid are both shown.

Accessibility.decision: Use label, describedby, aria-invalid, inputmode numeric, autocomplete cc-number, and paste-friendly formatting.
Accessibility.behavior: The field is operable with keyboard, paste, and assistive tech.
Accessibility.rejectIf: No label or missing invalid state.

Depth.decision: Keep card number as a field-level surface; enrollment depth belongs to patterns.
Depth.behavior: The component does not open nested payment or ownership flows.

Tone.decision: Use direct recovery tone for local validation and avoid approval language.
Tone.behavior: The user knows whether to correct the number.

Growth.decision: Escalate expiry, security code, tokenization, and ownership to sibling components or patterns.
Growth.behavior: Card Number remains one capture component.

Symbol.decision: Use the card symbol as an affordance beside visible label and helper text.
Symbol.behavior: Icon reinforces card capture without replacing text.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing and alignment inside the field control.
Iconography.behavior: Card icon aligns with Input rhythm across density.

props.name: value
props.notes: Formatted or raw card number value.

props.name: error
props.notes: Visible recovery message; overrides local Luhn message.

props.name: loading
props.notes: Shows a check in progress without claiming approval.

props.name: onValueChange
props.notes: Emits raw digits and local validation metadata.

productExamples.example: Capture card number before creating a passcode.
Collect card number before expiry and security code.

do: Use Luhn only as local structure validation.
dont: Do not own CVC, expiry, tokenization, ownership, or submit system.
info: Full card enrollment becomes a pattern after Card Number, Expiry, and Security Code components exist.

rejectIf: Owns backend validation, tokenization, card ownership, or submission
Value is not grouped or cannot be corrected
Autocomplete and numeric input mode are missing
